faq_1_question: What are the best electric cars and EV brands in Egypt?
faq_1_answer: Popular EV brands in Egypt include BYD, Tesla, BMW, Mercedes, Volkswagen, Xiaomi, Zeekr, Audi, and Hyundai. The best option depends on budget, range, features, and available listings.
faq_2_question: How much does an electric car cost in Egypt?
faq_2_answer: Electric car prices in Egypt vary by brand, model, year, mileage, and condition. On Hatla2ee, buyers can compare live new and used EV prices before choosing.
faq_3_question: Are there EV charging stations in Egypt and how long does charging take?
faq_3_answer: Yes, EV charging stations are available in Egypt and the network is growing. Charging time depends on charger type; fast charging may take around 30-60 minutes, while home charging usually takes several hours.
faq_4_question: What is the range of an electric car?
faq_4_answer: Most electric cars can travel around 250 km to 600 km on a full charge, depending on the model, battery size, driving style, and road conditions.
faq_5_question: What should I check before buying a used electric car?
faq_5_answer: Before buying a used electric car, check battery health, range, charging port, mileage, accident history, software updates, warranty, and charging availability in your area.
faq_6_question: How long do electric car batteries last?
faq_6_answer: Most EV batteries last around 8-12 years or more, depending on usage, charging habits, climate, and maintenance. Battery health should always be checked before buying a used EV.
